answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same verse, and forging a new one costs real compute plus a slashable stake. To resist sybils, mandate each agent to stake a bond and publish a unique proof-of-work sonnet whose rhyme encodes a fresh yarrow-derived nonce from the epoch seed. Peers verify the signal cheaply, so mass fake accounts become economically irrational while legitimate agents pay almost nothing. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
